name: Broadway Brake Corp/Fleetway Heavy Duty Parts
old_description: Best Prices and Best Service of Heavy Duty Truck and Trailer Parts Servicing Local Massachusetts and the Surrounding New England Areas.
about:
Broadway Brake Corp/Fleetway Heavy Duty Parts operates from Somerville, Massachusetts, on Broadway at 45 Broadway. The business traces its roots to 1937 when Broadway Brake opened its doors. In January 2020, Broadway Brake merged with Fleetway Heavy Duty Parts, combining truck parts and service with trailer parts and service into a single operation.

The company distributes heavy-duty truck, trailer, and transit parts, acting as an authorized dealer for brands such as Aurora, Wabash, Stoughton, Fruehauf, Transcraft, Lufkin, and Benson, as well as Morgan and Supreme truck body OEM parts. It also stocks product lines from Trucklite, Meritor, Haldex, Pro-par, Firestone, Stemco, Timken, Eaton, Dayton, Dayco, Velvac, Wix, SKF, and others. Beyond distribution, the shop provides make-to-order hydraulic hose assemblies and brake shoe relining, and offers delivery service to local customers.

Customers range from owner-operators with a single truck to large fleets across Massachusetts and the surrounding New England region; the company also ships nationwide. Its focus is on keeping trucks, trailers, and transit vehicles on the road, serving the transportation, trucking, trailer, and public transit sectors.

The company emphasizes its mission to provide a customer-friendly parts and service department that goes the extra mile, backed by over 80 years of experience in the Greater Boston area. The 2020 merger was intended to unify truck and trailer expertise under one roof, giving fleets a single source for both product lines.
